candidats.titre: File:Furniture made by students of technical school in Waterford Ireland 1910s (6666235323).jpg
candidats.description: You will all have to forgive this group's rather wooden poses! This is the fruits of the labour of students at a technical school in Waterford. Couldn't resist it on a number of grounds. Firstly, it wins the most unusual group photographed in a field category. Secondly, I had hoped that we'd be able to catch a glimpse of the photographer in one on the mirrors, but that was not to be... Date: 9 January 1916 NLI Ref.: P_WP_2642
categories: Photos uploaded from Flickr by Fæ using a script
